description: ZCC Self-Host Hall of Fame — every verified observability milestone in chronological order

milestones.description: Topology Auditor + Attestation. Introduced record.zxr, Merkle topology root, SHA-256 build identity.
Execution Fingerprint Engine. Introduced static instruction profile, register pressure analysis, stack growth model, control-flow root hash.
Replay Pack Engine. First portable build evidence capsule (.zrp): source, preprocessed, assembly, objects, topology, fingerprints, attestation in POSIX ustar format.
Genome Registry. Version-stamped topology snapshots enabling historical drift comparison.
Lineage Engine + Time Machine. Point-to-point drift reconstruction across arbitrary version spans.

Full observability milestone. Adds Stability Observatory (D-24), Topology Bisector (D-25), Cross-Compiler Genome (D-26), Sovereign Build Ledger (D-27), Runtime Behavioral Probe (D-28), Impact Attribution Engine + Function Heat Ranker (D-29). Closes the compiler observability arc: identity → behavior → reproducibility → history → prediction → localization → comparison → provenance → runtime fidelity → causality.
